title: Repair Reserve for Appraisals Made Subject to Completion or Repairs, Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant
content:
**Appraisal desk note — Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant down payment**

An appraisal made subject to completion or repairs adds a repair reserve the borrower funds to the reserve the borrower keeps in the down payment. Whether the value was made subject to completion or repairs is read from the Appraisal Order on the loan file; the loan program is read from the borrower's Mortgage Loan File.

- On an FHA or VA file (Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed or Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed) whose appraisal is subject to completion or repairs, the repair reserve is 500.00.
- On any other file whose appraisal is subject to completion or repairs, it is 300.00.
- An appraisal made as is adds nothing.

| Appraisal Order made subject to completion or repairs | Loan program | Repair reserve |
|---|---|---|
| yes | Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed or Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 500.00 |
| yes | any other program | 300.00 |
| no (made as is) | any program | nothing |

### Cases (hypothetical files)

- A Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed file whose appraisal requires a final inspection after repairs: repair reserve 500.00.
- A Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed file with the same kind of appraisal: repair reserve 300.00.
- A Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed file appraised as is: no repair reserve.
